label: EmeraldChampions_Text_KubfuInfo
text: A Dark Scroll and a Water Scroll\nlead KUBFU to different styles.\pThis second partner lets you explore\nboth paths with your original KUBFU.$

label: EmeraldChampions_Text_CosmogInfo
text: COSMOEM evolves into SOLGALEO by\n day or LUNALA at night.\p This second COSMOG lets you\n explore both paths. Use your\l Leveler when ready.$

label: gText_EmeraldChampionsExplainRepelSpray
text:
Use it and wild Pokémon leave you
 alone for 500 steps. When it wears\l off, you can mist the air again.\p Fishing, Rock Smash and Sweet Scent
 are never blocked.\p SWEET SCENT gives a 25% chance of
 an available local legendary.\p Several legends in one area share
 that chance. Their requirements apply.$

label: Route119_Text_JacksonIntro
text: A RANGER reads the ground. Here the\n ground is TAPU KOKO's own terrain.$

label: Route120_Text_LorenzoIntro
text: Fitness check! OGERPON sets the pace,\n STARMIE keeps it. Can you keep up?$

label: Route120_Text_LeonelPostBattle
text: Travelers with five BADGES have\n spotted OGERPON in this route's\l grass.\p It's a rare sight. SWEET SCENT can\n help draw out the local\l discoveries.$

label: Route121_Text_MarcelIntro
text: My gang has never tasted defeat.\n ZERAORA, show them why!$

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_DariusIntro
text: TORNADUS gives TAILWIND priority.\n BRAVIARY rides the gust behind it.\p Four turns. Outlast them!$

label: MossdeepCity_Text_LifeNeedsSeaToLive
text:
With the MIND BADGE, MANAPHY and
 PALKIA can appear among wild\l POKéMON on the SEAFLOOR CAVERN\l seabed.\p DIVE at ROUTE 128 and search near
 the submarine.\p Each has a 1% chance. SWEET SCENT
 gives a 25% chance of an\l available legendary, shared\l between them.$

label: Route102_Text_CatchWholeBunchOfPokemon
text:
I thought I saw a flower move...
 Then a little green POKéMON ran\l through the grass!\p SHAYMIN! Right here, so close to home!
 You could meet it on your first trip.\p It has a 1% encounter chance.
 SWEET SCENT raises that to 25%.$

label: Route111_RuinsExterior_Text_Archaeologist
text:
The storms leave strange patterns
 across these ruins. LANDORUS may\l be sheltering here.\p With the BALANCE BADGE, bring
 CASTFORM and help me survey the\l weather.\p Then LANDORUS can appear among
 the wild POKéMON here. Our work\l only needs doing once.$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_CaveOfOriginSleepsToo
text: The crisis has passed. You may\n explore the CAVE OF ORIGIN again.\p TERAPAGOS lives on B1F, the floor\n where you met WALLACE. Let me\l check its discovery record.$

label: DewfordMeadow_Text_Warden
text:
A little COSMOG drifted into our
 meadow. Keep an eye on the grass,\l even on your first visit!\p MELOETTA answers songs. With the
 KNUCKLE BADGE, bring a partner\l with SING and we'll perform\l together.\p Once it answers, you can keep
 looking for it here. We only need\l to sing together once.\p With the HEAT BADGE, you may also
 spot MUNKIDORI. SWEET SCENT helps\l draw out these rare visitors.$

label: ScorchedSlab_B2F_Text_Warden
text: A white dragon has been glimpsed\n among these hot stones. RESHIRAM!\p With the FEATHER BADGE, you can\n search for it here. HEATRAN dwells\l farther below.$

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_CresseliaAwakened
text: DARKRAI's capture has revealed a\n new lead: CRESSELIA shelters in\l the rear B1F room of METEOR\l FALLS.\p With six badges and our ORB, it\n can appear among wild POKéMON\l there.$

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_CresseliaAwaits
text: CRESSELIA can appear among wild\n POKéMON in METEOR FALLS' rear B1F\l room, after six badges and our\l ORB.$

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_TimeSignDormant
text: DIALGA can appear in METEOR\n FALLS' main B1F chamber with the\l MIND BADGE. It needs no dream\l POKéMON.$

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_DialgaAwakened
text: With the MIND BADGE, DIALGA can\n appear among wild POKéMON in the\l main B1F chamber of METEOR FALLS.$

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_DialgaAwaits
text: Search the main B1F chamber of\n METEOR FALLS for DIALGA. SWEET\l SCENT helps draw out local\l legends.$

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_GroudonKyogreTale
text:
GROUDON raised the land and
 KYOGRE carved the sea. Their\l clash grew until neither could\l stop.\p RAYQUAZA descended and calmed
 them. The RED and BLUE ORBS were\l left in our care.\p With the FEATHER BADGE, TAPU LELE
 and Galarian MOLTRES can appear\l in the outside grass. Receiving\l our ORB adds YVELTAL.\p With the MIND BADGE, GIRATINA can
 appear on the sixth floor.\p Each is a 1% wild encounter.
 SWEET SCENT gives 25%, shared\l among the available legends in\l that area.$

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_HoennTrioTale
text:
RAYQUAZA restored the balance.
 You helped HOENN find a way\l through.\p With the MIND BADGE, search the
 sixth floor for GIRATINA. It has\l a 1% wild encounter chance.\p SWEET SCENT raises its chance to
 25%.$

label: AlteringCave_1F_Text_Researcher
text:
This cavern feels like a doorway.
 The deeper I go, the stranger it\l becomes.\p With the BALANCE BADGE, you may
 find HOOPA among the wild POKéMON\l here. It's rare; SWEET SCENT\l helps.\p MEWTWO waits on B1F. It accepts
 challengers with the MIND BADGE.$

label: Route119_Text_WeatherInstitute
text: WEATHER INSTITUTE\p After rescuing the researchers,\n the BALANCE BADGE lets you find\l TORNADUS in ROUTE 119's tall\l grass.\p It has a 1% encounter chance.\n SWEET SCENT raises that to 25%.$

label: Route110_Text_MauvilleCitySign
text:
ROUTE 110: MAUVILLE CITY to the
 north.\p RAIKOU can appear in the grass
 with the KNUCKLE BADGE. The\l BALANCE BADGE adds TAPU KOKO.\p With five badges, rescuing the
 WEATHER INSTITUTE adds THUNDURUS.\p Each is a 1% encounter. SWEET
 SCENT gives a 25% chance of an\l available legendary, shared\l evenly.$

label: Route117_Text_ArentTheseFlowersPretty
text:
Aren't these flowers pretty? I
 love watching the POKéMON wander\l through them.\p Lately, an odd one with a metal
 mask has been hiding in the grass.\l DEVON calls it TYPE: NULL.\p With the KNUCKLE BADGE, you can
 search for it here. It's very\l rare, but SWEET SCENT helps draw\l it out.$

label: Route120_Text_RouteSignFortree
text:
ROUTE 120: FORTREE CITY to the
 west.\p With the BALANCE BADGE, MESPRIT
 and OGERPON can appear in this\l route's grass.\p The FEATHER BADGE adds XERNEAS
 and Galarian ARTICUNO.\p Each is a 1% encounter. SWEET
 SCENT gives a 25% chance of an\l available legendary, shared\l evenly.$

label: NewMauville_Inside_Text_RotomCaught
text:
The ROTOM CATALOG changes ROTOM
 into its five appliances.\p With the BALANCE BADGE, MELTAN
 can appear among this plant's\l wild POKéMON.\p Finish WATTSON's generator job
 and report back to add ZERAORA.\l Catch REGISTEEL to add REGIELEKI\l too.\p The FEATHER BADGE then adds
 ZEKROM. Each is a 1% encounter;\l SWEET SCENT gives 25%, shared\l among those available.$

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_SamanthaIntro
text: GOTHITELLE closes the exit. AZELF\n plots, and then ends the board.\p You cannot run from this one!$

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_TrainerTipsPP
text:
FOREST FIELD NOTES\p CUT opens paths into the deeper
 forest. With the STONE BADGE,\l CELEBI can appear in the third\l area.\p The KNUCKLE BADGE adds VIRIZION
 in the second area. The HEAT\l BADGE adds WO-CHIEN there.\p Each is a 1% wild encounter.
 SWEET SCENT gives a 25% chance of\l an available local legendary.$

label: GraniteCave_StevensRoom_Text_IveGotToHurryAlong
text:
I'm heading east. MAGMA and AQUA
 are disturbing more than land and\l sea.\p With the STONE BADGE, COBALION
 can appear among wild POKéMON on\l GRANITE CAVE B2F.\p It has a 1% chance. SWEET SCENT
 increases that to 25%.\p DEVON's researcher lists the
 other legendary locations and\l requirements.$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_ResearchRewardComplete
text: The tools let KYUREM, ZYGARDE,\n NECROZMA, and CALYREX change\l forms or combine with certain\l partners.\p There's always something new to\n learn about POKéMON!$

label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_PokemonChangesWithWeather
text:
CASTFORM changes with the
 weather. Let it show you what a\l storm can do.\p Now that our work can continue,
 five badges let you find TORNADUS\l on ROUTE 119 and THUNDURUS on\l ROUTE 110.\p Search their grass. Each has a 1%
 chance; SWEET SCENT gives 25%,\l shared with other local legends.\p A researcher at ROUTE 111's
 elevated ruins also needs\l CASTFORM for a weather survey.$

label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_RevealGlassPurpose
text: This REVEAL GLASS changes the forms of\n TORNADUS, THUNDURUS, and LANDORUS.\p The northern bridge is clear now.\n Follow ROUTE 119 to FORTREE's GYM.$

label: MtPyre_6F_Text_PecharuntDormant
text: PECHARUNT waits here. Earn the\n MIND BADGE and catch OKIDOGI,\l MUNKIDORI and FEZANDIPITI to\l challenge it.$

label: MtPyre_6F_Text_PecharuntNeedsPartner
text: The three masks belong to OKIDOGI,\n MUNKIDORI and FEZANDIPITI.\p Catch all three, then return here.\n They do not need to travel with you.$

label: EverGrandeCity_DrakesRoom_Text_IntroSpeech
text:
DRAKE. Last of the four, and the one
 who's sailed the longest.\p Dragons remember every age of battle.
 SALAMENCE can bring a TAILWIND.\p KORAIDON brings sunlight for
 RESHIRAM's flames.\p Keep something for MEGA GARCHOMP.
 Come on!$

label: PetalburgWoods_3_Text_Ranger
text: CELEBI has been slipping between\n the trees. With the STONE BADGE,\l you can find it in this grove's\l grass.\p It has a 1% encounter chance.\n SWEET SCENT raises it to 25%.$

label: SandstrewnRuins_Text_Archaeologist
text: Every fossil here tells us how a\n POKéMON lived. Imagine this place\l before the desert!\p Those green lights below us may be\n ZYGARDE. Search B1F after earning\l the BALANCE BADGE.$

label: Route114_FossilManiacsTunnel_Text_NotSafeThatWay
text:
Oh... Be careful! I was digging
 when the wall fell into an\l enormous cavern.\p With the HEAT BADGE, TING-LU can
 appear in the DESERT UNDERPASS.\p It also connects to SANDSTREWN
 RUINS. With the BALANCE BADGE,\l ZYGARDE can appear on the ruins'\l B1F.\p Each is a 1% wild encounter in
 its habitat. SWEET SCENT raises\l that chance to 25%.$

label: Route112_Text_MtChimneySign
text: MT. CHIMNEY\p For LAVARIDGE TOWN or the summit,\n please take the CABLE CAR.\p FIELD NOTE: ENTEI has been sighted\n in FIERY PATH. Search after earning\l the DYNAMO BADGE.$

label: Route123_Text_RouteSignMtPyre
text: {UP_ARROW} MT. PYRE\p Travelers report TAPU BULU in the\n grass on ROUTE 123. Search with\l the FEATHER BADGE.\p It is a rare wild discovery. SWEET\n SCENT may help you find it.$

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_EdgarPostBattle
text:
You've made it this far. Keep
 going and become the CHAMPION!\p They say VICTINI appears on this
 floor to TRAINERS with all eight\l BADGES. A rare bit of luck on a\l hard road!\p Try SWEET SCENT if you're looking
 for it.$

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_NicolasPostBattle
text:
With the FEATHER BADGE and
 REGIROCK recorded as caught,\l REGIDRAGO can appear on this\l floor.\p It has a 1% wild encounter
 chance. SWEET SCENT raises that\l to 25%.\p DEVON's guide lists the
 discoveries in the other METEOR\l FALLS rooms.$

label: MauvilleCity_Text_WattsonWontBeChallenge
text:
WATTSON: Don't you worry about it.
 It won't be a challenge to you.\p The entrance to NEW MAUVILLE is just
 a short SURF away from ROUTE 110.\p That's it, then, you have my trust!
 Wahahahaha!\p WATTSON: If you find MELTAN, level it
 up in NEW MAUVILLE to get MELMETAL.\l The generator can be on or off!$

label: MauvilleCity_Text_WattsonYoungTakeCharge
text: WATTSON: Wahahahaha!\p It pleases me to no end to see\n the young step up and take charge!\p WATTSON: If you find MELTAN, level it\n up in NEW MAUVILLE to get MELMETAL.\l The generator can be on or off!$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_LegendarySignResearcherIntro
text:
HOENN is full of rare discoveries.
 You can find them at your own pace.\p Some legendaries have a 1% chance
 to appear among wild POKéMON.\p SWEET SCENT gives a 25% chance of
 an available local legendary.\p If several are available there,
 they share that chance evenly.\p Check each entry for its BADGE,
 story and partner requirements.\p If one escapes or faints, keep
 looking. It can appear again.\p Others await you at special places
 or come from rewards.\p I keep leads for every discovery,
 including ones you have completed.$
